category_title: Students without academic skill deficits who engage in active/disruptive work avoidance
scenario_title: Small-group reading instruction with disruptive behavior
minimal_context: Martin is participating in a small-group reading activity in his second-grade classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our small-group reading. Please open your books and read the next page quietly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns his body completely away from the assigned materials) I already know how to read. I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to read along with the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of his seat and leans over to the student next to him) Hey, what are you doing after school today?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Martin, please sit down and focus on your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays out of his seat, ignoring the book, and continues talking loudly to his peer) I don't want to read this! Did you see the new superhero movie?
